historical_record.description: Fugazi Hall, formally the Casa Coloniale Italiana John F. Fugazi — a steel-framed building with a theater and rooms for Italian community organisations, commissioned by the banker John F. Fugazi and designed by Italo Zanolini.
Listed in the 1968 citywide survey of San Francisco's architectural heritage as Fugazi Building.
Recorded in the city's 1982 survey of North Beach, adopted by the Board of Supervisors in 1999, as an individually listed resource.
Identified by the 2019 updated North Beach survey as appearing eligible for local landmark or California Register / National Register status — recorded as Fugazi Hall.

unknowns: The city's survey dates Fugazi Hall to 1912 in its property-type chapter and figure caption and to 1913 in its account of North Beach halls.
